standard_prerequisites.name: Base change for the derived lower shriek over a cartesian square of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with f separated finite type: g^{-1} composed with Rf_! equals Rf'_! composed with (g')^{-1} (more-etale, Lemma lemma-base-change-shriek, canonical tag 0F7L)
standard_prerequisites.use: The named input: pulling back Rf_!K to the geometric fibre over a point of Y is computed by Rf'_! on the fibre, which is the compactly supported cohomology construction of the fibre.

core_obligations: Immediate consequence: for the geometric point y of Y, take the cartesian square of the fibre over y; the base change isomorphism of lemma-base-change-shriek (tag 0F7L) identifies the stalk of Rf_!K at y with Rf'_! of the restriction of K to the fibre, which by the section's definitions is the compactly supported cohomology complex RGamma_c(X_y, K restricted to X_y) (proof lines 4323-4326).
proof_roadmap: Apply the named base change lemma over the geometric fibre (proof lines 4323-4324).
Recognize the resulting functor as the compactly supported cohomology of the fibre by the definitions (proof lines 4324-4325).
